issue.title: <Image> Props don't declare quality, though it is forwarded to Astro's Image
issue.body:
### Description

`<Image>` from `emdash/ui` (`EmDashImage.astro`) forwards extra props to Astro's `<Image>` through `...attrs`, so `quality` already works at runtime for local media. The rendered URL gets `q=70`. But `Props` extends `HTMLAttributes<"img">` and doesn't declare `quality`, so `astro check` rejects it:

```
src/components/Photo.astro:24:118 - error ts(2322): Type '{ image: never; alt: string; width: number | undefined; height: number | undefined; sizes: string; priority: boolean; quality: number | undefined; class: string; }' is not assignable to type 'IntrinsicAttributes & Props'.
  Property 'quality' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & Props'.
```

Expected: `quality` is typed, since it is passed through. Something like:

```ts
/** Output quality for optimized variants (Astro image service). Local media only. */
quality?: ImageQuality; // or number | "low" | "mid" | "high" | "max"
```

Workaround: `{...{ quality }}`, because TypeScript skips the excess-property check on spread props.

### Steps to reproduce

1. In a site that uses `emdash/ui`: `<Image image={post.data.featured_image} quality={70} />`
2. Run `astro check`, which reports the error above.
3. Run the site: the `/_image` URL still contains `q=70`.

### Environment

- emdash 1.0.1, @emdash-cms/cloudflare 1.0.1, astro 7.3.5
- Node.js 26.7.0
- Runtime: Cloudflare Workers
- OS: Linux

### Screenshots

Not applicable.
